Markets.title: How Warren Buffett's 'big error' may finally be paying off after a decade
Markets.summary: Warren Buffett's $37 billion acquisition of Precision Castparts, previously called an expensive mistake, may finally be paying off. Supply shortages and a rival acquisition by GE Aerospace have reportedly increased the company's value to about $100 billion.

Markets.title: Oriental Insurance hopes to turn corner in FY27 assisted by NSE stake dilution
Markets.summary: Oriental Insurance Company expects to achieve a profitable financial turnaround by the 2026-27 fiscal year. This recovery will be supported by a planned dilution of its National Stock Exchange stake through an upcoming initial public offering starting September 17.

Markets.title: ETMarkets Smart Talk| From floor trading to AI algos: Why India’s retail traders are entering the automation era, says Shruti Jain
Markets.summary: AI-powered algorithmic trading is becoming increasingly accessible to Indian retail investors through trading APIs and zero-code platforms supported by SEBI regulations. According to Shruti Jain of Arihant Capital, this automation helps improve execution speed, reduce emotional bias, and establish a new mainstream trading habit.

Markets.title: Inside NSE IPO journey: Why India's largest exchange took 10 long years to reach Dalal Street
Markets.summary: After a decade of regulatory and legal delays, including a co-location controversy and a Supreme Court settlement, the National Stock Exchange is finally launching an IPO. The offering consists entirely of an existing shareholder share sale without raising new capital for the exchange.

Markets.title: Nifty may rebound to 23,800; Rupak De picks Apollo, Laurus Labs and Eternal for the week

Geo-Political.summary: US President Donald Trump dismissed warnings about artificial intelligence risks, arguing that addressing them could hinder America's technological competition with China. He stated that concerns are being raised by "negative forces" about scenarios that will not happen.

Geo-Political.summary: Sweden's election authority released partial count projections after Sunday's vote showing the left-wing opposition bloc winning a one-seat majority. This leaves the two major political blocs effectively tied while the final results are determined.

Geo-Political.title: Six dead, 130 missing after Indonesian ferry capsizes in Java Sea
Geo-Political.summary: Six people died and 130 others are missing after the Virgo Transport 8 ferry capsized in the Java Sea. Ships and helicopters are currently searching for the missing passengers following the bad weather incident.

Geo-Political.summary: Turkish police detained dozens of individuals during raids on gay bars and the homes of LGBTQ+ activists. Human rights groups accuse the Turkish government of using a family-values campaign to target the LGBTQ+ community.

India.title: Bid To Revive Ladakh Lake That Shrunk By 70% In A Decade
India.summary: Ladakh's administration is attempting to revive a local lake that has shrunk by 70 percent over the past decade. Officials are rerouting water from the Rupsho Kharnak glacier stream, which sits at an altitude of 18,045 feet.

India.title: 'Op Safed Sagar' Veteran Attacked With Iron Rod By Parking Staff In Gurugram
India.summary: An 'Op Safed Sagar' veteran was attacked with an iron rod by a parking attendant in Gurugram last week. The assault occurred after the victim went to park his car while visiting a restaurant with his family for dinner.

India.title: Sheesh Mahal Row Returns? Panel To Inspect Arvind Kejriwal's Former House
